assets.description: One gleeful round body-and-face character with stick limbs and no separate torso stands beside a compact table. One hand holds a flat end of an origami strip on the tabletop while the other raises it overhead in a gentle arc. Repeating diagonal creases form triangular folded facets in the paper itself. Sparse black outlines, white interiors, restrained gray facet shading, and a transparent background match the course character family.
